{{Quote|I need your help. They took my best racing durnis. All three of them. Do you know how hard it is to train a racing durni? Well, to be honest, it's not really all that difficult. But still, those were mine! I spent years training them.|Galvain Tark, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:RtSRD" />}}
'''Galvain Tark''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] [[Beastmaster/Legends|animal handler]] who lived on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Tark owned three [[durni]]s and worked hard for years to train them as racing durnis.<ref name="SWG:RtSRD" /> However, In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the durnis were stolen by the criminals of the [[Chirq Council]] and held captive in a [[Jzoro's Bunker|bunker]] near the city of [[Doaba Guerfel/Legends|Doaba Guerfel]]. Galvain Tark thus hired a spacer to recover the animals. The spacer infiltrated the bunker successfully and managed to liberate the three durnis and bring them back to their master.<ref name="SWG:RtSRD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Galvain Tark was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Galvain Tark was added to the game with the update named "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives, Publish Notes, June 8th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=48548|text="Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives", Publish Notes, June 8th}}</ref>
